mapper.select: select message_id, from_user_id, to_user_id, message_type, title, content, related_type, related_id, read_flag, create_time, del_flag, case when read_flag = '1' then 1 else 0 end as is_read, case when related_type = 'POST' then related_id else null end as related_post_id from lf_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' order by create_time desc, message_id desc limit 100
select count(1) from lf_message where to_user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into lf_message ( from_user_id, to_user_id, message_type, title, content, related_type, related_id, read_flag, create_time, del_flag ) values ( #{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{messageType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, '0', sysdate(), '0' )
mapper.update: update lf_message set read_flag = '1' where to_user_id = #{userId} and read_flag = '0' and del_flag = '0'
